quote: Every vehicle driven upon a divided highway must be driven only upon the right-hand roadway and must not be driven over, across or within any dividing space, barrier or section or make any left turn, semicircular turn or U-turn, except through an opening in the barrier or dividing section or space or at a crossover or intersection established by a public authority.

activation.condition: the highway is divided AND the subject is driven on it

obligation.description: Do not leave the right-hand roadway, cross its divider, or make a U-turn except at a permitted opening, crossover, or intersection.

exceptions.trigger: Turn uses an opening in the barrier or dividing space
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Use the opening for the turn and otherwise remain on the right-hand roadway
exceptions.source_clause: except through an opening in the barrier or dividing section or space

exceptions.trigger: Turn uses a crossover or intersection established by public authority
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Use the established crossover or intersection and otherwise remain on the right-hand roadway
exceptions.source_clause: or at a crossover or intersection established by a public authority.

timing.description: the right-hand-roadway duty holds at every instant; the crossing of the dividing space, or the turn, is the act judged

judgment_calls_needed.note: whether a crossover was 'established by a public authority' is an administrative fact; the observable substitute is the physical opening

source_required_observations.note: the dividing space, barrier or section, with its opening attribute
the two separate roadways of the divided highway
which roadway the footprint is on, and any overlap of the dividing space
the right-hand roadway for the subject's direction
driving on the roadway of the opposite direction

source_residue: whether a crossover was 'established by a public authority' is an administrative fact; the observable substitute is the physical opening
